# Firecrawl Knowledge Ingest

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — ingest public or authenticated knowledge bases and docs portals with the Firecrawl browser: JS-heavy docs, login-gated portals, paginated help centers, support knowledge bases, or structured JSON/markdown extraction from documentation sites. The browser opens the portal, inspects navigation, follows sidebar links, next links, pagination, load-more controls or search, scrapes article content as markdown, and extracts metadata (title, section, last-updated date, author). Distinct from the four published firecrawl-build-* listings: those cover API integration; this is a business workflow for absorbing documentation. Requires a Firecrawl API key — Firecrawl is a hosted, likely paid service. By @firecrawl, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: authenticated portals need credentials provided by the user; heavy or very large portals may need a page limit to stay economical. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
